title: Classification of European Illex coindetii and Loligo forbesii Squid Stocks by Trace Element Analysis of Statoliths
content:
ABSTRACT

We investigated whether statolith microchemistry analysis could classify ommastrephid and loliginid squid species into fishery stocks. Statolith nucleus (early life stage) and edge (life stage at time before catch) of Illex coindetii (Verany, 1839) and Loligo forbesii (Steenstrup, 1856) from various areas of the North East Atlantic Ocean and Mediterranean Sea during 2021–2022 were analysed using laser ablation ICP-MS to measure values of 11 trace elements (Na, Mg, Mn, Fe Co, Cu, Zn, Sr., Ba, Pb and U) next to calcium. Four stocks were categorised for I. coindetii and five stocks for L. forbesii amongst sample areas. Common hatching areas and migration into distinct fishing regions were also identified. Our results provide substantial information to sustainably manage fisheries for both species in European waters by providing stock definitions, spawning periods and migration patterns.
